thread:
eli: heads-up: several deploys for v2026-03-22 are failing at the promote step with 'cache lease not found' in remote-cache. started at ~11:07 UTC. anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: promote request id=prom-4221 -> step upload -> failed: PUT https://remote-cache/internal/leases/write-2026-03-22: 412 Precondition Failed: lease=locked-by-97; owner not found; retrying 2/4

sophia: yep saw a spike in lease contention alerts. runners are retrying which floods the cache and makes it worse.

devops: quick options: A) pause promotions and extend change window (delay rollout); B) manually pin to previous promoted build (build-2026-03-19-e3f4) and push that to prod to meet customer timelines. Both need follow-ups.

release-lead: change window is small today (sales demo 15:00). ops prefers B if safe. what's the risk of pinning?

devops: risk is minimal if previous build passed the same canaries. We need to re-run smoke checks against canary routing and update release-notes. Also open a ticket for cache lease bug.

sre-oncall: mitigation we can try immediately: reduce aggressive retry from CI runners to 2 attempts and enable a short backoff on cache client. patch command for runner config: ```kubectl -n ci patch cm runner-config -p '{"data":{"cache.retries":"2","cache.backoff_ms":"250"}}'``` I'll monitor lease churn for 10m.

eli: sounds good. I propose: 1) apply retry/backoff patch; 2) if canaries remain healthy, do manual pin to build-2026-03-19-e3f4; 3) create an incident ticket to investigate lease owner leak. ack?

sophia: ack. I'll run the manual promote once backoff is in.

deploy-bot: manual promote queued by sophia at 1745801505: step1 snapshot -> success; step2 upload -> pending.

release-lead: I'll open RD-9402 to track the lease contention postmortem and link it to this release board. will update release-notes to indicate we pinned to last-green build due to cache lease contention.

eli: thanks team. posting this thread to release board and will update if anything flips.
